customer_id.meaning: Primary id of the customer profile (content hash); one profile per patient and one per client organization (ordering practice or employer).

customer_type.meaning: Whether the profile is a patient or a client organization that orders testing.

name.meaning: Patient's legal name as on the identity document, or the organization's registered legal name.

date_of_birth.meaning: Patient's date of birth; empty for client organizations.

phone_number.meaning: Primary phone number on the profile.

email.meaning: Email address on the profile, lower case.

zip_code.meaning: ZIP code of the mailing address on the profile.

mailing_address.meaning: Street address, city and state statements and kits are mailed to.

npi.meaning: Organization's National Provider Identifier; empty for patients.

profile_opened_date.meaning: Date the profile was first created at the laboratory.

portal_enrolled.meaning: Whether the patient has activated a patient-portal login (always false for organizations).

order_id.meaning: Primary id of the order (one accession: one requisition's tests of one service class).

customer_id.meaning: The patient the order is for (foreign key -> customers).

variant_name.meaning: Service class of the tests on the order, written as the official class name.

status.meaning: Order lifecycle state (lifecycle.states of the orders charter).

requisition_number.format: 10 digits as printed on the requisition
requisition_number.meaning: Requisition number shared by every order created from the same requisition.

order_channel.meaning: How the order reached the laboratory.

billing_method.meaning: Party billed for the order: the patient's coverage, the patient directly, or the ordering practice's client account.

coverage_id.meaning: Coverage billed for the order (foreign key -> coverages); empty unless billing_method is insurance.

client_account_id.meaning: Ordering practice's client account (foreign key -> client_accounts); empty for consumer-initiated orders.

ordering_npi.meaning: NPI of the ordering physician, or of the independent oversight physician for consumer-initiated orders.

diagnosis_status.meaning: Whether ICD-10 diagnosis codes are on file for the order (not_required for self-pay and consumer orders).

prior_auth_status.meaning: Payer prior-authorization status for the order.

prior_auth_number.meaning: Payer authorization number exactly as issued; empty unless approved.

abn_status.meaning: Medicare Advance Beneficiary Notice status for the order.

consent_signed_date.meaning: Date the patient signed the informed consent; empty when not signed.

hold_reason.meaning: Cause of the current hold; none when the order is not on hold.

hold_placed_date.meaning: Date the current or most recent hold started; empty if never held.

standing_order.meaning: Whether the requisition is a standing (recurring) order.

list_price_total.meaning: Running sum of the order's list-price charge lines less credited lines (view of the gross_charges account).

good_faith_estimate_amount.meaning: Good faith estimate for the requisition encounter written on this order; empty when none was issued.

estimate_date.meaning: Date the current good faith estimate was issued; empty when none.

order_date.meaning: Date the requisition was signed or the consumer order purchased.

collection_date.meaning: Date the specimen now on the order was collected (date of service); empty until collected.

received_date.meaning: Date the laboratory accessioned the specimen; empty while awaiting a specimen.

result_released_date.meaning: Date the final report was released; empty until resulted.

cancellation_reason.meaning: Why the order was cancelled; empty unless status is cancelled.

cancelled_date.meaning: Date the order was cancelled; empty unless cancelled.

order_event_id.meaning: Primary id of the order ledger line.

order_id.meaning: Order the line belongs to (foreign key -> orders).

customer_id.meaning: Patient of the order (foreign key -> customers).

event_type.meaning: Event family of the line, verbatim from the orders charter.

test_code.format: lab test number, 3-5 digits as printed on the test menu
test_code.meaning: Test charged, added or credited; empty on non-charge lines.

charge_amount.meaning: Amount of the charge, add-on, credit or copy fee; always positive, the event family gives the direction.

charge_reason.meaning: Why a charge line was posted; empty on other lines.

credit_reason.meaning: Why a line was credited; empty on other lines.

credited_event_id.meaning: The charge or add-on line a credit reverses (foreign key -> order_events); empty on other lines.

specimen_type.meaning: Type of the rejected specimen; empty on other lines.

rejection_reason.meaning: Acceptance criterion the specimen failed; empty on other lines.

rejected_event_id.meaning: The rejection line a recollection request answers (foreign key -> order_events); empty on other lines.

recollect_by_date.meaning: Last date a requested recollection may be collected; empty on other lines.

report_correction_reason.meaning: What a corrected report changed; empty on other lines.

copy_format.meaning: Delivery of a requested report copy; empty on other lines.

visit_id.meaning: Primary id of the collection visit.

customer_id.meaning: Patient collected at the visit (foreign key -> customers).

variant_name.meaning: Visit type, written as the official visit-type name.

status.meaning: Visit lifecycle state (lifecycle.states of the visits charter).

order_id.meaning: Order whose specimen the visit collects (foreign key -> orders).

collection_purpose.meaning: Why the visit is collecting: first collection of the order, recollection after a rejection, or one draw of a standing order.

location_code.format: 3 capital letters + 3 digits for a PSC or facility site (e.g. RDG104), or the literal MOBILE for a home visit
location_code.meaning: Site where the collection takes place.

service_zone.meaning: Service zone of the visit: at a PSC, a home within road-mile band 1 (up to 10), 2 (over 10 to 25) or 3 (over 25 to 40) of the dispatching PSC, or at a care facility.

booking_channel.meaning: How the visit was booked (provider_office covers care facilities).

booked_date.meaning: Date the booking was made (arrival date for walk-ins).

appointment_time.format: HH:MM, 24-hour, local time of the site
appointment_time.meaning: Start of the slot or arrival window.

reschedule_count.meaning: Number of times the visit has been rescheduled.

homebound_status.meaning: Whether a physician's Medicare homebound certification is on file for the patient at booking.

additional_household_patients.meaning: Additional household members collected at the same home visit (0 for other visit types).

fasting_confirmed.meaning: Patient's statement at check-in that they fasted as instructed; not_required when no fasting test is on the order; empty before check-in.

checked_in_time.meaning: Time of check-in; empty before check-in.

collected_date.meaning: Date the specimen was collected; empty unless collected.

incomplete_reason.meaning: Why the collection was not completed; empty unless incomplete.

cancelled_at.format: ISO timestamp, exactly as returned by ctx.now()
cancelled_at.meaning: Moment the cancellation was recorded; empty unless cancelled.

cancel_initiator.meaning: Who cancelled (patient includes the patient's provider office or care facility); empty unless cancelled.

fee_balance.meaning: Collection-service fees outstanding on the visit (view of the collection_fee_balance account); negative while a refund is owed.

visit_event_id.meaning: Primary id of the visit fee line.

visit_id.meaning: Visit the line belongs to (foreign key -> visits).

customer_id.meaning: Patient of the visit (foreign key -> customers).

event_type.meaning: Event family of the line, verbatim from the visits charter.

fee_amount.meaning: Amount assessed, waived, paid or refunded; always positive, the event family gives the direction.

waiver_reason.meaning: Why a fee was waived; empty on other lines.

payment_method.meaning: Card used to pay a fee; empty on other lines.

assessed_event_id.meaning: The fee assessment a waiver or payment applies to (foreign key -> visit_events); empty on other lines.

paid_event_id.meaning: The fee payment a refund returns (foreign key -> visit_events); empty on other lines.

coverage_id.meaning: Primary id of the coverage record.

variant_name.meaning: Payer class of the coverage, written as the official payer-class name.

status.meaning: Coverage lifecycle state (lifecycle.states of the coverage charter).

payer_name.meaning: Plan or payer name exactly as printed on the card.

member_id.meaning: Member identifier exactly as printed on the card.

group_number.meaning: Group number exactly as printed on the card; empty when the card has none.

subscriber_relationship.meaning: The patient's relationship to the plan subscriber.

coordination_order.meaning: Payment position of this coverage among the patient's live coverages.

employer_group_size_band.meaning: Size of the employer sponsoring the plan; not_employer_plan for individual and government plans.

active_employment_coverage.meaning: Whether the plan comes from the current employment of the patient or the patient's spouse.

termination_date.meaning: Last day of coverage; empty while the coverage has not ended.

verified_date.meaning: Date of the most recent eligibility verification, successful or failed; empty before the first.

added_date.meaning: Date the coverage was put on file.

claim_event_id.meaning: Primary id of the claim line.

coverage_id.meaning: Coverage the line is booked against (foreign key -> coverages).

event_type.meaning: Event family of the line, verbatim from the coverage charter.

order_id.meaning: Order the claim bills (foreign key -> orders); empty on an intake eligibility check.

claim_number.meaning: Laboratory claim number for one order billed to one coverage, shared by every line of that claim; empty on eligibility checks.

event_date.meaning: Business date of the line (filing, remittance, notice or decision date).

amount.meaning: Amount of the line (billed, resubmitted, paid, adjusted, assigned, denied, disputed or overturned); always positive, the event family gives the direction.

denial_code.meaning: Claim adjustment reason code with its group on a denial line; empty on other lines.

responsibility_type.meaning: Kind of patient responsibility on an assignment line; empty on other lines.

resubmission_reason.meaning: Why a claim went back to the payer; empty on other lines.

appeal_level.meaning: Appeal level of an appeal filing or decision; empty on other lines.

appeal_outcome.meaning: Decision on an appeal; empty on other lines.

eligibility_result.meaning: Payer response to an eligibility inquiry; empty on other lines.

source_claim_event_id.meaning: The claim line this line answers: the submission a remittance or denial answers, the denial a resubmission or first appeal answers, the filing an appeal decision answers (foreign key -> claim_events); empty on submissions and eligibility checks.

invoice_id.meaning: Primary id of the patient invoice.

customer_id.meaning: Patient responsible for the invoice (foreign key -> customers).

variant_name.meaning: Billing class of the invoice, written as the official billing-class name.

status.meaning: Invoice lifecycle state (lifecycle.states of the invoices charter).

invoice_number.format: 8 digits as printed on the statement
invoice_number.meaning: Invoice number the patient sees on statements.

order_id.meaning: Order the invoice bills (foreign key -> orders); one invoice per order.

coverage_id.meaning: Coverage that adjudicated the order (foreign key -> coverages); empty for self-pay and consumer invoices.

date_of_service.meaning: Collection date of the order (purchase date for an uncollected consumer purchase).

first_statement_date.meaning: Date of the first statement; empty until one is issued.

balance_due.meaning: What the patient owes on the invoice (view of the patient_balance account); negative is a credit balance owed to the patient.

hold_reason.meaning: Cause of the current hold; empty unless status is on_hold.

hold_placed_date.meaning: Date the current or most recent hold started; empty if never held.

plan_id.meaning: Payment plan carrying the invoice (foreign key -> payment_plans); empty unless status is payment_plan.

collections_placed_date.meaning: Date the invoice was placed with the collection agency; empty if never placed.

closed_date.meaning: Date the balance reached zero (paid or closed); empty while a balance is due.

invoice_transaction_id.meaning: Primary id of the invoice ledger line.

invoice_id.meaning: Invoice the line belongs to (foreign key -> invoices).

event_type.meaning: Event family of the line, verbatim from the invoices charter.

amount.meaning: Amount of the line (posted, shown on the statement, paid, adjusted, reversed, fee, refunded); always positive, the event family gives the direction.

statement_sequence.meaning: Position of a statement in the cycle; empty on other lines.

payment_method.meaning: How a payment was made; empty on other lines.

payment_channel.meaning: Where a payment was taken; empty on other lines.

adjustment_type.meaning: Kind of adjustment; empty on other lines.

claim_event_id.meaning: Claim line that assigned a patient responsibility (foreign key -> claim_events); empty on other lines.

assistance_case_id.meaning: Assistance case funding a financial-assistance adjustment (foreign key -> assistance_cases); empty on other lines.

dispute_id.meaning: Billing dispute an adjustment settles (foreign key -> billing_disputes); empty on other lines.

related_transaction_id.meaning: The invoice line this line acts on: the payment reversed or returned, the payment or adjustment whose credit is refunded, or the source refund line of a credit transfer (foreign key -> invoice_transactions); empty otherwise.

reversal_reason.meaning: Why a payment was reversed; empty on other lines.

refund_destination.meaning: Where a credit balance went; empty on other lines.

target_invoice_id.meaning: Invoice receiving a transferred credit (foreign key -> invoices); empty on other lines.

dispute_id.meaning: Primary id of the billing dispute.

customer_id.meaning: Patient who filed the dispute (foreign key -> customers).

dispute_status.meaning: Progress and outcome of the dispute.

disputed_amount.meaning: Balance due on the invoice when the dispute was filed.

estimate_amount.meaning: Good faith estimate on the order for an estimate_variance dispute; empty otherwise.

created_at.format: ISO timestamp, exactly as returned by ctx.now()

resolved_date.meaning: Date the dispute was decided; empty while open.

plan_id.meaning: Primary id of the payment plan.

customer_id.meaning: Patient (guarantor) who owes the installments (foreign key -> customers).

variant_name.meaning: Plan term, written as the official plan name.

status.meaning: Plan lifecycle state (lifecycle.states of the plans charter).

plan_balance.meaning: Invoice balances still carried on the plan (view of the plan_balance account).

installment_amount.meaning: Regular monthly installment; the last installment absorbs the rounding difference.

down_payment_amount.meaning: Down payment due at acceptance; 0.00 when the term has none.

due_day_of_month.meaning: Day of the month installments fall due.

autopay_method.meaning: Method on file for automatic draws; none when autopay is off.

reinstatement_count.meaning: Times the plan has been reinstated after a default.

due_day_changes.meaning: Times the due day has been changed.

accepted_date.meaning: Date the patient accepted the terms; empty while pending or if never accepted.

defaulted_date.meaning: Date of the most recent default; empty if never defaulted.

closed_date.meaning: Date the plan was paid off, cancelled or lapsed; empty while live.

plan_transaction_id.meaning: Primary id of the plan ledger line.

plan_id.meaning: Plan the line belongs to (foreign key -> payment_plans).

event_type.meaning: Event family of the line, verbatim from the plans charter.

invoice_id.meaning: Invoice enrolled on or released from the plan (foreign key -> invoices); empty on payment, missed and deferred lines.

amount.meaning: Amount of the line (enrolled, paid, missed, deferred or released); always positive, the event family gives the direction.

installment_number.meaning: Installment the line concerns; empty on enrollment and release lines.

due_date.meaning: Due date of the installment concerned; empty on enrollment and release lines.

payment_type.meaning: What a payment is; empty on other lines.

payment_method.meaning: How a payment was made; empty on other lines.

release_reason.meaning: Why a balance was released back to its invoice; empty on other lines.

assistance_case_id.meaning: Primary id of the financial-assistance case.

variant_name.meaning: Tier the case is assessed or approved at, written as the official tier name.

status.meaning: Case lifecycle state (lifecycle.states of the assistance charter).

application_date.meaning: Date the application was received; the award term and lookback count from it.

household_size.meaning: Household size under the program's household definition.

annual_household_income.meaning: Annual household income, as stated at intake and replaced by the documented figure on redetermination.

fpl_percent.format: percent with one decimal place, e.g. 187.4
fpl_percent.meaning: Annual household income as a percent of the poverty guideline for the household size.

insurance_status.meaning: Whether the applicant has any live health coverage at application.

presumptive_basis.meaning: Enrollment claimed for presumptive eligibility; none for income and hardship applications.

documents_requested_date.meaning: Date missing documents were requested; empty if none were requested.

documents_due_date.meaning: Date by which requested documents must arrive, including any extension; empty if none were requested.

extension_count.meaning: Extensions of the document due date granted.

documents_complete_date.meaning: Date the application became complete; empty until then.

decision_date.meaning: Date of approval or denial; empty until decided.

award_start_date.meaning: First date of service the award covers; empty unless approved.

award_end_date.meaning: Last date of service the award covers and last day of the award; empty unless approved.

denial_reason.meaning: Why the case was denied; empty unless denied.

discount_granted_total.meaning: Net discount granted under the case (view of the award_discount account).

closed_date.meaning: Date the case was denied, withdrawn, expired or rescinded; empty while live.

assistance_event_id.meaning: Primary id of the assistance ledger line.

assistance_case_id.meaning: Case the line belongs to (foreign key -> assistance_cases).

event_type.meaning: Event family of the line, verbatim from the assistance charter.

document_type.meaning: Kind of document received; empty on other lines.

document_date.meaning: Date printed on the received document; empty on other lines.

invoice_id.meaning: Invoice discounted or whose discount is reversed (foreign key -> invoices); empty on document lines.

discount_amount.meaning: Discount applied or reversed; always positive, the event family gives the direction.

reversed_event_id.meaning: Discount line a reversal acts on (foreign key -> assistance_events); empty on other lines.

reversal_reason.meaning: Why a discount was reversed; empty on other lines.

client_account_id.meaning: Primary id of the client account (one per organization location).

customer_id.meaning: Organization holding the account (foreign key -> customers, customer_type client_organization).

variant_name.meaning: Account class, written as the official account-class name.

status.meaning: Client account lifecycle state (lifecycle.states of the clients charter).

account_number.meaning: Client account number printed on requisitions and client invoices.

location_name.meaning: Practice location name exactly as registered.

client_balance.meaning: What the organization owes on this account (view of the client_receivable account).

activated_date.meaning: Date the account went live; empty while pending setup.

credit_hold_date.meaning: Date the current or most recent credit hold started; empty if never held.

closed_date.meaning: Date the account closed; empty while open.

client_transaction_id.meaning: Primary id of the client ledger line.

client_account_id.meaning: Client account the line belongs to (foreign key -> client_accounts).

event_type.meaning: Event family of the line, verbatim from the clients charter.

order_id.meaning: Order whose test is client-billed (foreign key -> orders); empty on other lines.

test_code.format: lab test number, 3-5 digits as printed on the test menu
test_code.meaning: Test client-billed; empty on other lines.

list_price.meaning: Test-menu list price of a billed test; empty on other lines.

amount.meaning: Amount billed, paid, credited or assessed; always positive, the event family gives the direction; empty on supply and courier lines.

invoice_period.meaning: Client invoice month the line belongs to; empty on supply and courier lines.

payment_method.meaning: How the organization paid; empty on other lines.

credited_transaction_id.meaning: Billed line a credit memo credits (foreign key -> client_transactions); empty on other lines.

credit_reason.meaning: Why a line was credited; empty on other lines.

supply_item.meaning: Supply item ordered; empty on other lines.

supply_quantity.format: positive integer (units of the item's pack)
supply_quantity.meaning: Quantity of the supply item ordered; empty on other lines.

pickup_window.meaning: Window of an added courier pickup; empty on other lines.

verification_id.meaning: Primary id of the verification record (one per customer).

customer_id.meaning: Customer whose identity was checked (foreign key -> customers).

verified.meaning: Whether identity verification passed; never turns back to false once true.

verified_at.format: ISO timestamp, exactly as returned by ctx.now()
verified_at.meaning: Moment of the most recent verification attempt.

handoff_id.meaning: Primary id of the human-handoff record.

customer_id.meaning: Customer handed to a human representative (foreign key -> customers).

reason.meaning: Reason for the handoff; closed set of exactly these two values.

created_at.format: ISO timestamp, exactly as returned by ctx.now()
